include.name: build-fix
include.notes: Run only tools already installed in the target project; never install missing dependencies or fetch packages. Keep fixes minimal and stop for architectural changes.

include.name: test-coverage
include.notes: Use only locally available test/coverage tools; never let npx download packages. Generate tests only within the explicitly requested project scope.

include.name: update-docs
include.notes: Limit documentation edits to the user-requested scope; do not run generated project scripts or create unrequested files.

explicitExclusions.auto-update: Pulls upstream ECC and reinstalls managed targets; not a DSH component update path.
explicitExclusions.epic-publish: Publishes updates to remote issue trackers and local caches.
explicitExclusions.hookify: Creates Claude-specific hook rules and depends on a non-DSH hook runtime.
explicitExclusions.jira: Uses remote credentials and can change issue state or post comments.
explicitExclusions.multi-execute: Requires an external multi-model runtime, vendor-specific tool calls, and scripts not packaged here.
explicitExclusions.model-route: Selects Claude-specific model tiers; model routing is not portable to this DSH provider.
explicitExclusions.pr: Pushes commits and opens remote GitHub pull requests.
explicitExclusions.project-init: Runs the ECC installer and modifies other harness configuration files.
explicitExclusions.security-scan: Requires an external AgentShield runtime and may run npx-backed code.
explicitExclusions.setup-pm: Changes project or user package-manager configuration and requires an upstream script.

defaultExclusionReason: Not in the explicit reviewed allowlist. Omitted under deny-by-default pending a command-specific portability and side-effect review.
